title: Truncation of an integer multiplicity current at a good radius: an IM current in ℝ^P agreeing with S on B_ρ(0), without boundary there, with M_O(Ŝ) ≤ M_O(S), finite mass and finite boundary mass
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) integer multiplicity, and R ∈ ℝ with R > 0 and closedBall(0, R) ⊆ U such that ∂S(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_R(0). Then there are ρ ∈ ℝ with R/4 < ρ < R/2 and an integer multiplicity Ŝ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) such that: (a) Ŝ(ω) = currentEval(S, ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_ρ(0); (b) ∂Ŝ(β) = 0 for every β ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with tsupport β ⊆ B_ρ(0); (c) M_O(Ŝ) ≤ M_O(S) for every open O ⊆ ℝ^P (massOn); (d) M(Ŝ) < ∞; (e) M(∂Ŝ) < ∞ (mass = massOn univ, in [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < R → closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ U → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 R → S.boundary ω = 0) → ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (Ŝ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), R / 4 < ρ ∧ ρ < R / 2 ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Ŝ ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball 0 ρ → Ŝ ω = currentEval S (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) ∧ (∀ β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 ρ → Ŝ.boundary β = 0) ∧ (∀ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O → Ŝ.massOn O ≤ S.massOn O) ∧ Ŝ.mass < ∞ ∧ Ŝ.boundary.mass < ∞
